citation.title: Experimental identification of I-mode characteristics at the edge of FIRE mode in KSTAR
citation.authors: Heo, C.; Park, S.J.; Choi, G.J.; Kim, J.; Kim, E.-J.; Jeon, Y.M.; Choi, M.J.; Han, H.; Sung, C.; Hahm, T.S.; Na, Y.-S.
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1088/1741-4326/adacfc (printed in the article header as its own DOI)

topic: Edge of KSTAR FIRE mode in the unfavorable (USN) configuration: CES Ti pedestal, L-mode-like edge ne, weakly coherent mode (WCM) in BES, and bicoherence.
own_question: Whether the FIRE-mode edge shows I-mode-like features, and how edge turbulence relates to the temperature pedestal.
actual_method_and_evidence: The analysis is offline. It uses BES cross-power, coherence, conditional k-f spectra, cross-bicoherence and auto-biphase on time windows (e.g., 0.2 s). The paper presents a scatter of summed coherence in two frequency bands against CES Ti,edge (rho_N about 0.94). This uses 672 time points from eight USN discharges (BT 1.8–1.9 T, Ip 0.5 MA). Points were binned and averaged; no predictive model was built. CES Ti was available only between beam blips. The edge Te pedestal was not resolved because of Thomson scattering uncertainty.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: In KSTAR FIRE-mode plasmas, the prominence of the edge BES WCM was reported to correlate with CES edge Ti (a pedestal-height proxy).
claim_checks.qualification: Descriptive correlation from binned offline windows. It is not a causal estimator, not real-time, and not a test of incremental predictive information. The campaign and year are not stated.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: BES offers ion-scale 2D edge density-fluctuation data that is spectrally linked to edge ion-temperature structure, motivating BES as an auxiliary input.
claim_checks.qualification: Physics motivation only. The paper does not report mechanism identification for nowcasting.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: CES Ti is reported only between NBI beam blips. Spectra used 0.2 s windows. No report-arrival times, latency, or ECEI usage are given. The paper does not say whether the CES Ti is impurity or main-ion.
validation_if_relevant: None. There is no held-out data, train/test split, or predictive validation.
forbidden_inferences: That BES predicts CES Ti causally or at a 10 ms resolution
That the discharges belong to the KSTAR2022 campaign or overlap with our data
That the CES Ti is carbon-impurity, unless verified elsewhere
That the regulatory or zonal-flow interpretation is proven
Generalizing these findings to all I-mode or pedestal regimes
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Cite as KSTAR-specific evidence that BES edge spectral features co-vary with CES edge Ti. This motivates testing whether BES adds incremental information, without implying predictive skill.
